limits: Two chat repeats and one random run per setting; no statistical superiority claim.
Client-disconnect/reuse probe passed; no per-kernel tracing or prolonged stability qualification.
Only a 32K aggregate pool was tested here; the 64K request is separate.
Chat prompts are repetitive synthetic prose, code and structured records, two repetitions each; they are not uniformly random token prompts.
The chat template forces thinking with a 256-token budget; 512 output tokens include reasoning.
TTFT-derived prefill includes API and first-token overhead; it is not isolated kernel throughput.
Each random C1/C4 group was measured once; cross-checkpoint timing changes can depend on different generated outputs and speculative acceptance.
